llm.summary: The skill's requests and runtime instructions are coherent with its stated purpose (querying TickerDB via an API) and its single required secret (TICKERDB_KEY) is proportionate to that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill is described as an API client for TickerDB and only requires an API key (TICKERDB_KEY). No unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths are requested, which matches the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains typical API usage and an email-based auth flow (POST /auth, POST /auth/verify) that requires the user to provide an email and a 6-digit code. This is coherent with issuing/obtaining an API key, but it means the agent will see the user's email and verification code and will present the returned apiKey to the user for optional persistent storage. Users should understand that those values are sensitive.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install step (instruction-only). Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by the skill itself, which is the lowest-risk install pattern.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only TICKERDB_KEY is required and declared as the primary credential. That is exactly the credential expected for an external API client; no extra secrets or unrelated env vars are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The instructions ask the agent to offer to save the returned API key and state "OpenClaw persists it automatically" upon user confirmation. Persisting the API key is reasonable for convenience, but users should be aware the skill expects to store that secret and should confirm how to view/revoke stored keys in the platform.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: call TickerDB endpoints and requires only the TICKERDB_API key. Before installing or running it, decide whether you're comfortable: (1) providing your email and the 6-digit verification code to the agent during sign-up (these are needed only to issue/retrieve the API key), (2) allowing the platform to persist your TICKERDB_KEY if you confirm — verify how to view/revoke stored keys in OpenClaw, and (3) whether you want the agent to set up recurring reports/webhooks (the skill mentions scheduling but doesn't document where or how webhooks are hosted). Confirm the domain (api.tickerdb.com) is correct, and do not paste other unrelated secrets into the chat.
